title: When I Grow Up
intro: What do you want to be?

parentTip.vi: Hỏi con "What do you want to be when you grow up? Why?" và kể về nghề của bố mẹ bằng tiếng Anh.
parentTip.say: What do you want to be?

chat.ask: Do you want to be a photographer?
chat.yes: Cool! You can take great photos!
chat.no: Okay! There are lots of other jobs!

gaps.s: I've got toothache. I need to see the ___.
Our car is broken. Let's take it to the ___.
The ___ wrote a story about our school in the newspaper.

text.title: My Family's Jobs
lines: My dad is an engineer. He builds bridges.
My aunt is a journalist. She writes for a newspaper in London.
My uncle is a photographer. He takes photos of famous people.
I want to be a dentist because I like helping people.

questions.q: What does the writer want to be?
